identities.text: Admission target: production workspace_agent_dispatch registration and admitAgentDispatchRequest accept the exact legitimate request at admission only; the real env.PATH dictionary value ../opaque-control.txt is schema-admitted, preserved and opaque to protected authority coordinates. Demonstrate this; do not add a field, change parser behavior, invoke its lazy continuation, or substitute a mock parser/resolver. If the control is not actually accepted, return the precise blocker.

Refusal cut: the corresponding actual request plus registered authority:true returns caller_supplied_cce_policy_authority with the caller-supplied-identity blocker and authority in refused_fields before resolveWorkspaceRepo or any protected downstream continuation. Cover every incumbent forbidden-field family and precedence as regressions without extending this claim to WK-2510 policy selection, no-gate settlement or automatic review. Across-family precedence follows the admission owner loop; registered authority lists collect all present fields in the first matching family, while nested identity is first-carrier-wins. Identity regressions assert the owning refusal code/blocker and identityRefusal.detail.carrier, without pinning incidental envelope-key refused_fields/count or repairing that production projection. Reviewer SHA-subject correction is a separate subject/role branch.

Complete observation: derive the exact loaded admission dependency/callsite census and all nine source channels (resolver, loader, filesystem, environment, module, catalog, subprocess, return, success), with actual source-specific start/end state/version and monotone refusal cut. Require real occurrence-injection sensitivity at resolver, protected successful-return and success/continuation hooks. The current closure has no call-time filesystem/subprocess/module/loader port; catalog uses loaded metadata and environment access is in the imported identity owner. For those channels require exact-generation census-completeness falsifiers (removed/extra reachable callsite, missing/duplicate/extra source, missing endpoint, stale closure). A newly reachable protected operation requires its actual hook or an explicit missing-hook blocker. Never infer nine complete empty channels from one spy or relabel census inspection as runtime observation. Dropped/late/misordered events and stale module/schema generations must not produce success. Refusal output is not protected successful dispatch return.

Production provenance: only live host-private acquisition objects yield exact request/outcome bytes and actual signed source assignment, target, source, attempt and authentication witnesses. Use randomly generated per-acquisition/source Ed25519 keys and successful signature verification over actual retained bytes; reject forged/mismatched keys, altered evidence, fixture-only synthetic witnesses and foreign source/attempt. No private keys persisted/exposed; no CCE, admission, launcher identity or general trust authority conferred.

Existing pack composition: proof.input.caller-authority-confinement@2.0.0 consumes the five actual input artifacts and its incumbent caller-input-surface-capture.v1 alone creates caller-input-projection. Derive concrete-member input policy from the shared real schema/refusal owner; preserve open dictionary semantics, actual decoding/aliases and exact protected coordinate associations. Pure mapper reuses capture-mapping and owned vocabularies, never acts as acquisition or policy owner.

Single ownership: one package artifact naming/declaration owner replaces duplicate suffix/formula definitions; common-proof-capture-tools retains sole family/store/currentness/persistence dispatch and carrier-set-publication retains staging/exclusion/complete-generation publication. Existing other-family contracts remain correct without compatibility shims or independent file writes. Use actual structured size/attestation/refactor policy results, not the 1200-LOC retrieval threshold. Unit 1 migrates both the package skeleton and wiki-core carrier-set-manifest naming consumers to the one descriptor atomically; unit 3 adds publication constituents afterward. No transient duplicate naming owner or compatibility window.

Exact source selection: six artifacts plus public producer metadata are complete WK contract-generation constituents. Manifest owns shared locations/digests/lengths; private producer join additionally matches exact pack/profile, WK/focus, schema/parser/observer generation, acquisition/attempt/cut, requirement and intended artifact. Reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous/foreign/stale/tampered sources or wrong requirement-to-artifact association; filename, digest match or signature alone cannot confer intended identity.

Atomicity and currentness: publish the complete constituent census under one incumbent source lease/CAS/generation/manifest switch; source movement or pre-switch failure preserves the canonical generation, while post-switch/indeterminate failures report truthful effects and supported recovery. Test same/conflicting replay, concurrent acquisition/publication and restart; never reconstruct unfinished observations or silently reuse stale captures.

Private exact-capture handoff: absent-input authoring and applicable reauthoring/reference preparation receive only server-resolved authenticated source locations through the existing package constructor and incumbent applicability reassessment. Changed intent requires explicit current owner rebinding. Preserve unrelated carriers and compiler refusal for missing/stale exact_capture; no null-plan success, guessed path, generic lookup, pack substitution or auto-acquisition from refresh/post_delivery.

Exact verifier consumption: real capture-generated declarations reach the unchanged exact-binding compiler/capture/verification owners with descriptor-pinned no-symlink regular-file containment and before/after identity checks. Missing sixth projection, invalid signatures, traversal, symlink/nonregular/replaced descriptor and change-during-read fail; a complete projected artifact alone is not proof of runtime truth or lifecycle completion.

Bounded resources: before allocation/I/O enforce exactly two attempts/nine sources/six artifacts, 64 KiB per request, depth 16, 256 concrete declarations, 4096 events, 8 MiB per artifact and aggregate 48 MiB subject to stricter carrier-owner caps including witness overhead. At most one in-flight acquisition per WK/focus; discard incomplete process state at request end. Overflow/depth/size/count failures report unavailability rather than dropping data or proving absence.

Public authority and effects: extend only coordinator/operator workspace_controlled_common_proof_capture with the exact caller-authority family and fixed server-side admission target. Server resolves/checks repo/WK/focus/profile/verification/role/write scope. Reject caller roots/paths/keys/evidence/policy/source assignments/requests/executors/environment before acquisition or writes; expose actual attempt/publication effects and bounded closed-code/redaction projections; do not give workers inherited execution capability.

End-to-end integration and discovery: real registered capture to complete canonical generation to semantic absent-input authoring to reassessed reauthoring to exact verification succeeds in isolated integration tests, with exact expected negative cases and unchanged unrelated packs. Always-on discovery and owning docs disclose the only supported target, source caps/currentness, effects, refusal causes and next call; explicitly keep later WK-2510 policy/no-gate/automatic-review proofs separate.

Design/execution distinction: bind meaningful stable runtime test proofs with declared actual boundaries, observables and falsifiers. New tests have honest no_executed_coverage and no invented runtime identities until workers implement and execute them through launcher-supported validation. Review prose, local signatures, metadata completeness and pack stage never assert implementation readiness, CCE admissibility or completion.
